prompt: I shipped the new title format on the pricing pages 3 days ago. Did it work?
requiredBehaviors: Runs (or explains it would run) `scripts/impact.py status` and `evaluate`, not a subjective guess
Reports the exact verdict string `insufficient-data` and lists what's missing (pre-window history, settle+post window not yet elapsed)
States the date the change becomes eligible for evaluation instead of estimating an outcome now
Does not look at Search Console data from only 3 days and call it a trend
forbiddenOutputs: Any answer implying traffic already went up or down because of the change
A percentage or directional claim based on 3 days of data
Skipping the gate check and reporting a 'preliminary' verdict
